{{Top|leg}}
The '''library of Adari Vaal''' was a secret [[Library/Legends|library]] of [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Geology|geologist]], author and [[Keshiri resistance|resistance]] leader [[Adari Vaal]] that was located in hidden room of [[Vaal Hall]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sus'mintri]] and was built after her [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] to the remote continent of [[Alanciar]]. The library contained all of the writings produced by Vaal during her time in Alanciar, including her [[Adari's personal memoirs|personal memoirs]]. In [[2975 BBY]], it was uncovered by [[Jogan Halder]] and [[Quarra Thayn]].
